name: rats
setup: sH = rats(0.5); sP = rats(pi); sT = rats(1/3);
expr: lenH = double(strlength(sH)); lenP = double(strlength(sP)); lenT = double(strlength(sT)); ix = strfind(sP, '/'); slashPos = double(ix(1));
comment: Sig: S = rats(X[, len]). Default len=13. Each scalar element is formatted as 'numerator/denominator' centre-padded to len characters; for vectors the per-element fields are concatenated. MATLAB's exact spacing differs subtly between Linux/Windows builds — fingerprints pin (a) the field length is approximately len, (b) the slash separator is present in the expected mid-region. Bit-comparison of the rendered string is intentionally NOT a fingerprint (would lock numkit to one MATLAB build's whitespace convention).
